source_snapshot.procedure: Match recipe; clear logs; change all/random Uncore settings; save/reboot and confirm retention; Load Defaults/save/reboot and confirm SPEC; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; requires a person for interactive BIOS but omits unsafe random values and Uncore fabric impact.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required a reversible domain-aware matrix, exact defaults, UPI/PCIe/NUMA/memory/cache/power/RAS evidence, preserved counters and physical recovery.

old_problem: The historical record awaited Uncore defaults, safe values, affected-domain acceptance and recovery because Master requests all/random modification and log clearing.
disposition_reason: The approved BIOS rule establishes safe reversible, one-setting-at-a-time execution and prohibits all/random changes. Applied independently to Uncore, it yields a complete safe method when each value is bound to its UPI/PCIe/cache/NUMA/memory/power effects. Exact oracles and recovery remain runtime project configuration rather than a reason to keep Review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2178, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2179 / Wistron-BIOS-00496-V004 / 13065b57d1051261 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Reject all/random; approve one reversible Uncore control or coherent dependency group per checkpoint.
Bind platform, CPU stepping/socket population, BIOS/microcode, topology and authoritative project defaults.
For each value define expected effects and compare UPI/PCIe links, NUMA/memory, cache/frequency/power indicators and RAS deltas.
Qualified operator performs KVM save/reboot/Load-Defaults and photographs every state; automation only organizes read-only evidence.
Preserve SEL/AER/EDAC/MCA/kernel counters; sign boot limits, stop conditions and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery before save.
No BIOS setting, log/counter, reboot, Load Defaults, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Controlled Uncore persistence, fabric-health and default-restoration validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved reversible Uncore control persists and restores to Project SPEC while expected UPI, PCIe, cache, NUMA, memory and power-domain behavior remains healthy.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
Project-default and domain-aware reversible value matrix
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator captures baseline Uncore page, topology and preserved counters; changes one approved reversible control or coherent dependency group, saves/reboots, verifies POST/readiness and every declared affected domain, re-enters BIOS to prove retention, then performs approved Load Defaults and repeats page/topology/health comparisons. Stop at the first anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved value persists; every reboot meets signed readiness, link/topology/effective-state and RAS limits; after Load Defaults all scoped values and affected domains equal the authoritative project oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for the approved matrix with screen evidence and matching signed UPI/PCIe/NUMA/memory/cache/power/RAS criteria. Wrong value, no-boot, link downgrade/loss, topology drift or prohibited error is FAIL. Missing runtime oracle or recovery is BLOCKED; no arbitrary value is exercised.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact platform/page, defaults, values/dependencies/effects, limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or unqualified Uncore controls.
Preserve existing SEL/AER/EDAC/MCA/kernel evidence and counters; no clearing.
Operator controls every save/reboot/Load-Defaults/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/BIOS/microcode/topology identity
Baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots
Per-phase UPI/PCIe links, NUMA/memory, cache/frequency/power and readiness comparisons
Restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on the first link, topology, health or boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore the last-known-good setting through KVM or signed physical/CMOS recovery; no blind reboot, power cycle or retry.

source_conflict.reason: Target and acceptance consistently cover Uncore persistence/default restoration; unsafe all/random wording is safely constrained without dropping domain coverage.

blocked.reason: The safe manual Uncore method is clear; exact values, affected-domain oracles and recovery are runtime inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Platform/Uncore identity, Project SPEC defaults, reversible values/dependencies/effects, UPI/PCIe/NUMA/memory/cache/power/RAS limits, Load-Defaults scope and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED MANUAL TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO BIOS, LOG, REBOOT, DEFAULT, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BIOS/Uncore platform owner and qualified KVM/physical operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign page-specific values, affected-domain acceptance and recovery before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: User-approved ED-11 BIOS safety principle and ED-01 through ED-30
external_authorities.application: Uses the approved one-setting-at-a-time boundary while retaining Uncore-specific fabric/topology evidence.

project_authority: BIOS/Uncore owner signs controls, defaults, affected-domain criteria and recovery; operator performs manual workflow; end engineer owns verdict.
